name: Teknora CRM
author: Juliana Rodrigues Guimarães

sections.description:
🚀 Stop using expensive and complex CRMs.

Manage your leads, sales pipeline and client relationships directly inside WordPress — simple, fast and fully integrated.

Teknora CRM was built for small businesses, freelancers and agencies that want full control of their sales process without relying on external platforms or monthly subscriptions.

Capture leads, organize contacts, track deals and manage follow-ups — all in one place.

🌍 Multi-language overview

🇺🇸 English

Teknora CRM is a lightweight and powerful CRM plugin designed to help you manage your entire sales process directly inside WordPress.

✔ No external tools
✔ No monthly fees
✔ Quick setup
✔ Built for performance

🇧🇷 Português

O Teknora CRM é um plugin leve e poderoso que permite gerenciar todo o seu processo de vendas diretamente dentro do WordPress.

✔ Sem ferramentas externas
✔ Sem mensalidade
✔ Configuração rápida
✔ Foco em performance

🇪🇸 Español

Teknora CRM es un plugin ligero y potente que permite gestionar todo su proceso de ventas directamente dentro de WordPress.

✔ Sin herramientas externas
✔ Sin suscripciones mensuales
✔ Configuración rápida
✔ Alto rendimiento

Why Teknora CRM?

No external platforms required
No monthly fees — 100% inside WordPress
Simple and intuitive interface
Fast and lightweight
Ready to grow with your business
Part of the Teknora ecosystem

What makes Teknora CRM different?

Runs entirely inside WordPress
No dependency on third-party CRM tools
Focused on simplicity and usability
Built for small businesses and real-world usage
Ready to integrate with Teknora Kanban and future plugins

Features

🇺🇸 English

Lead and contact management
Visual sales pipeline (deals management)
Task and follow-up tracking
Clean and organized dashboard
Shortcodes for lead capture
WhatsApp contact integration
Modular architecture for expansion
Integration-ready with other Teknora plugins

🇧🇷 Português

Gestão de leads e contatos
Pipeline de vendas visual (negociações)
Controle de tarefas e follow-ups
Dashboard limpo e organizado
Shortcodes para captura de leads
Integração com WhatsApp
Arquitetura modular para expansão
Pronto para integração com outros plugins Teknora

🇪🇸 Español

Gestión de leads y contactos
Pipeline de ventas visual
Seguimiento de tareas y actividades
Panel limpio y organizado
Shortcodes para captura de leads
Integración con WhatsApp
Arquitectura modular
Preparado para integraciones futuras

Perfect for

Freelancers managing client leads
Small agencies handling multiple clients
Local businesses capturing website leads
Real estate agents managing opportunities
Service providers organizing sales pipelines

Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes anywhere on your site:

[teknora_crm_form]
Displays a lead capture form.
[teknora_crm_whatsapp]
Displays a WhatsApp contact button.
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via ZIP.
Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
Access “Teknora CRM” from the admin menu.
sections.faq:
🇺🇸 English

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. The plugin is designed to be simple and user-friendly.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes. It works with most modern WordPress themes.

Can I integrate with other plugins?

Yes. It is designed to integrate with Teknora plugins like Kanban.

🇧🇷 Português

Preciso saber programar?

Não. O plugin foi feito para ser simples e fácil de usar.

É compatível com meu tema?

Sim. Funciona com a maioria dos temas modernos.

Posso integrar com outros plugins?

Sim. Integra com plugins Teknora como Kanban.

🇪🇸 Español

¿Necesito conocimientos de programación?

No. Está diseñado para ser fácil de usar.

¿Es compatible con mi tema?

Sí. Funciona con la mayoría de los temas modernos.

¿Puedo integrarlo con otros plugins?

Sí. Es compatible con plugins Teknora como Kanban.
